description: This file contains API functions for managing notes, categories, and settings in a note-taking web application. It includes imports, note initialization, local storage access functions, and exported functions for requesting and saving data.

methods.name: getLocalStorage
methods.description: Retrieves data from local storage by key, with optional error message.

methods.name: getUserNotes
methods.description: Fetches user notes from local storage, initializing with welcome and scratchpad notes if none exist.
